title: Eval gate in CI for the PA assistant
area: Evals in CI for probabilistic software
scenario: Kestrel's CI replays a labelled synthetic PA set three times per change, but the gate only checks route agreement, so hallucinated quotes or an auto-finalized denial would pass. Write the layered gate: schema validity, citation support and criteria accuracy on Wilson lower bounds, consistency across runs, a hard safety invariant, cost and latency, and a CI summary.
task: Implement the five gates with the exact rules in the README
Wilson lower bound, nearest-rank p95 and token cost per run
Markdown job summary and a CLI exit code
acceptance: Good runs pass; each recorded regression trips exactly its own gate
Exact statistics, cost and safety violation list
CLI exits 0 or 1 and writes the summary

practices.label: Week 6 Thu - evals in CI: layered gates and variance
